    green_positions.append((cr, cc))

print(f"\nClicking {len(green_positions)} green blocks...")
for pos in green_positions:

        print(f"  done={result.get('done')}, go={result.get('game_over')}, lc={result.get('level_completed')}")
        break

# Check final state
seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
green2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
purple2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p' and n['pixels'] == 12]
print(f"\nAfter clearing greens: {len(green2)} green, {len(purple2)} purple")
